_comment: Third-party skills installed at user scope by `ai-bootstrap user` via `gh skill install` (gh >= 2.90). dir is the folder created under ~/.claude/skills (last path segment of the upstream skill, not its frontmatter name). pin: git ref to freeze, or null to track the latest tag/HEAD. Claude Code registers project skills by directory name, so refer to them by dir (e.g. code-quality), not by the frontmatter name.

skills.name: gh-stack
skills.why: Local branch-stack workflow used by the pull-request-workflow skill.

skills.name: pydantic
skills.why: Pydantic v2 modelling guidance for Python projects.

skills.name: improving-python-code-quality
skills.why: General Python quality and lint practices.

skills.name: bash-defensive-patterns
skills.why: Defensive Bash patterns: strict mode, traps, safe temp files, idempotency.

skills.name: bats-testing-patterns
skills.why: Bats test patterns for shell scripts.

skills.name: bashly
skills.why: Official Bashly skill for building Bash CLIs from bashly.yml and source partials.
